body.summary: The built-in method filter drops only member calls on receivers not proven user objects: bare calls (except global functions), this/super calls and calls on the file's import bindings are kept whatever the name. The receiver scope stack is built from the AST (imports, every enclosing function/block/loop/switch/catch scope, the body). Bindings follow JavaScript: parameters, destructuring targets (not defaults or computed keys), loop bindings, const/let per block or switch, var per function (statements and for-in/of headers), nested function/class/abstract class/enum/namespace declarations, and a named function expression's own name shadow imports in their scope, closures included. Mutation-checked.
